\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=-5.

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 7 \tan{\left(- 5 x \right)} \sec{\left(- 5 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=- \frac{7}{5}\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}

$$
- \frac{7}{5}\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{7 \sec{\left(u \right)}}{5}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
- \frac{7 \sec{\left(- 5 x \right)}}{5}+C.
$$
